title: First voice download after high school: 'reality is subjective'

tellings.quote: The first one that I ever got was I was just out of high school and it didn't make any sense to me, which is was the voice was reality is subjective.

plain: A man named Brent Friedman says that just after high school he heard a voice for the first time, and all it told him was "reality is subjective." Friedman tells it as his own experience, and says the message made no sense to him then. He presents it as the first of several messages that came to him this way.
